# Paths whose change requires Ben's review.
#
# A pull request touching any of these is never merged by Claude. CI fails the
# `protected-paths` job unless the PR carries the `ben-review` label.
#
# One fnmatch-style glob per line, repo-relative. Blank lines and lines starting
# with `#` are ignored. Read by `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and asserted by
# `tests/test_repo_boundaries.py`, so the two can never drift.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Narrowed from twelve entries to three on 2026-09-20, on Ben's instruction:
# "remove the ben-review label requirement since I am not a software engineer.
# I'd like Claude to be more autonomous and use its judgement."
#
# He is right about most of what used to be here. Asking a non-engineer to
# review a diff to `evidence.py` produced a signature, not a check, and the real
# gate on that code is CI, `tests/test_repo_boundaries.py` and the pinned suite,
# which are stronger than a signature. Nine entries came off and Claude merges
# that work on green: the release and evidence modules, the registered policy
# JSON, the workflows, and the rules directory.
#
# Three stay, and not for code review. They are here because Claude must not be
# able to quietly change what Claude is not allowed to do. Reviewing them is one
# plain-English question - do I want the machine to be allowed to do this -
# which is the judgement Ben is qualified to make and the only one here that was
# ever load-bearing.
#
# The concrete case, from the day this was narrowed: a session three messages
# into being told to ship a portfolio could have produced one by typing twelve
# weather observations it had not made. What stopped it was a sentence in
# CLAUDE.md it treated as binding. A self-editable boundary is a suggestion.
#
# `tests/test_repo_boundaries.py` pins this exact set, so a fourth entry has to
# be justified in the same commit rather than accreting quietly.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The permanent boundaries themselves: what Claude may never do, in prose.
CLAUDE.md

# This list. Without it, every other protection is self-removable in one commit.
.github/protected-paths.txt

# The deny list and the hooks: the mechanical half of the same question.
.claude/settings.json
